subject: Conference room screen frozen right now
body: The display in the east conference room has been stuck on the loading logo since the meeting began. Attendees switched to a laptop instead. Facilities was told about a similar issue last quarter and it was resolved then, but this appears to be a separate occurrence.

subject: Coffee machine repaired this morning
body: The break room coffee machine that was leaking water yesterday afternoon has been fixed by the technician. It brewed a full pot this morning without any issues. Sharing this update so the ticket can be closed and nobody else reports the same fault again.

subject: Question about badge access hours
body: Could someone explain how the badge readers on the loading dock are supposed to work after hours? I want to understand whether contractors need a separate code or if the same badge covers weekend deliveries. Not reporting any trouble, just trying to plan next week's schedule.

subject: Ongoing trouble with the mail sorter
body: The mail sorting machine keeps jamming every few minutes and staff are pulling envelopes out by hand right now. It has been doing this since Monday and nobody has been able to make it run a full cycle since then. We need someone to look at it today.

subject: Elevator outage planned for next Tuesday
body: Maintenance will take the north elevator out of service for scheduled inspection. The lobby elevator will remain available the whole time. Please use the stairs or the other elevator if you are heading to the upper floors during that window and let your team know in advance.

subject: Thanks for fixing the thermostat
body: The heating in the second floor lounge is working well again after yesterday's visit from the technician. The room reached a comfortable temperature within an hour and has stayed steady since. Appreciate the quick turnaround, and no further action is needed on our end.

subject: Phone lines down at the front desk
body: Incoming calls are not connecting right now and callers report a busy tone even though nothing looks wrong on our end. This started about twenty minutes ago and has not cleared up despite restarting the handset twice. Visitors are having to email instead until this is resolved.

subject: Storage room reorganization request
body: Could we get approval to rearrange the shelving in the supply storage room? Nothing is broken, we just think a different layout would make it easier to find seasonal items. Let me know if there is a form to fill out or if I can start this weekend.

subject: Copier still jamming as I write this
body: The second floor copier stopped mid job and the paper is stuck inside the tray. Two of us have tried opening the panels without success. We have a report due this afternoon and need a working machine or a workaround as soon as someone is free.

subject: Recurring dropout on the guest network
body: The guest wifi cut out again this morning for the third time this week, and it is currently unreachable from the lobby. Visitors waiting for the meeting cannot load anything on their laptops. Each time it comes back briefly before dropping again within the hour.

subject: How the shift swap form works
body: New hires keep asking how the shift swap request works, so I wanted to check the current process with you before I explain it further. Does a supervisor need to approve every swap, or only the ones that cross departments? Nothing urgent, just want to get it right.

subject: Loading dock gate stuck open
body: The rear loading dock gate will not close and has been stuck in the open position since the early shift started. Trucks keep pulling up assuming it is fine, but the sensor is not resetting no matter how many times we cycle the switch. Security asked us to flag it.

subject: Server room fan making noise right now
body: One of the cooling fans in the server room is grinding loudly as I type this, and the temperature reading has climbed two degrees in the last hour. It has not stopped since we first noticed it after lunch. We are keeping an eye on the racks in the meantime.

subject: Update: parking gate issue already resolved
body: The parking gate that would not lift yesterday morning has been repaired by the vendor and tested several times since. It is opening and closing normally for every vehicle so far. Sending this note mainly for the record in case anyone else logged the same complaint.

subject: Request to change the break schedule
body: A few of us would like to propose moving the afternoon break by fifteen minutes to better match the delivery schedule. This is not about any problem with the current timing, just a suggestion based on how busy the dock gets right before the current break slot.

subject: Scanner errors continuing all morning
body: The barcode scanners at check in keep throwing an error every few scans and it is still happening as of this message. We have tried three different units and all of them show the same fault. Staff are writing numbers down by hand to keep the line moving.

subject: Air conditioning not cooling the lobby
body: The lobby has been warmer than usual since this morning and the thermostat reading keeps climbing even though the unit sounds like it is running. It is currently sitting well above the normal setting and guests have started commenting on it at the front counter.

subject: Fixed yesterday: kitchen sink leak
body: The slow leak under the kitchen sink that was reported earlier in the week has been sealed and dried out by the plumber. We checked again this morning and the cabinet floor is completely dry. Closing this out so it does not stay open on the tracking sheet.

subject: Intermittent outage hit again this morning
body: The card payment terminal at the front register dropped its connection for the third time today. Each time it comes back on its own after a couple of minutes but then cuts out again without warning. Customers are being asked to wait or use cash in the meantime.

subject: Planned maintenance window for the printer fleet
body: IT will be updating firmware on all networked printers this coming Saturday between eight and ten in the morning. Printing will be unavailable during that window across every floor. Please queue any large print jobs for Friday afternoon so they finish before the maintenance begins.

subject: Question about the visitor sign in kiosk
body: Does the visitor kiosk require a photo for every guest, or only for those staying longer than an hour? I am updating our front desk guide and want to describe the process accurately. No issues to report, just double checking the requirements before I finalize the document.

subject: Freight elevator jammed between floors
body: The freight elevator is currently stopped between the second and third floors with a delivery cart still inside. It has not moved in the last fifteen minutes despite pressing every button on the panel. We have taped off the doors on both landings until someone can help.

subject: Network drive still unreachable
body: The shared network drive has been down since early this morning and nobody on the floor can open their project files right now. We tried reconnecting from two different computers with no luck. This is holding up the reports that are due before the end of the day.

subject: No longer an issue: hallway light flicker
body: The flickering light in the third floor hallway that people mentioned last week has stopped since the bulb was swapped out on Tuesday. It has stayed steady every time I have walked past since then. Letting the team know so we can mark the complaint as closed.

subject: Delivery tracking system frozen
body: The delivery tracking screen has been frozen on the same shipment for over an hour and refreshing the page does nothing. Drivers are calling in to ask why their updates are not showing, and we still cannot confirm anything moved past the loading dock this morning.

subject: Suggestion for the supply request form
body: Would it be possible to add a dropdown for common supply requests instead of the open text box we use now? This is just a suggestion to save time filling it out, not a complaint about anything being broken. Happy to sketch out what the fields could look like.

subject: Vendor confirmed the wiring fault is fixed
body: The electrician came by yesterday afternoon and traced the wiring fault behind the conference room panel, then replaced the section that was causing the trip. Everything has run without a single trip since the repair. Passing this along so the incident can be closed out properly.

subject: Dispatch radio cutting out constantly
body: The dispatch radio has been cutting in and out all shift and right now we are only catching every other word from the trucks. It started around six this morning and has not settled down since, even after swapping the base unit battery twice.

subject: Still broken: badge reader at the side door
body: The badge reader by the side entrance has not accepted a single card since the shift began, so everyone is having to come through the main lobby instead. We reported this same reader last month and it worked fine after that fix, but it has failed again today.

subject: Clarifying the overtime approval process
body: I want to confirm the current steps for getting overtime approved before a shift starts. Does the request need to go through the shift lead first or straight to payroll? This is just for my own understanding, everything on our end has been running smoothly this week.

subject: Resolved this afternoon: forklift warning light
body: The warning light that kept coming on for forklift number four has been traced to a loose sensor cable, and the technician reconditioned the connection this afternoon. It has run three full loops since without the light returning. Noting this here for the maintenance log.

subject: Invoice system throwing errors again
body: The invoice system is throwing the same error message it did last month, and right now nobody can submit a completed invoice for approval. We have tried logging out and back in twice with no change. Finance is waiting on several of these before end of day.

subject: Ongoing leak near the loading bay
body: Water is still pooling near loading bay three and has been since the overnight shift noticed it. It keeps spreading a little more each hour and none of the mats we put down have kept up with it. We have cordoned off the area for now.

subject: Heads up: scheduled shutdown this weekend
body: Facilities will be shutting down power to the west wing this Saturday for planned electrical work. Nothing is currently wrong with the wiring, this is routine maintenance scheduled well in advance. Please save your work and unplug sensitive equipment before you leave on Friday.

subject: Appreciate the quick fix on the scanner
body: The handheld scanner that kept freezing last week has worked without a single hiccup since IT swapped the battery pack. We ran it through a full shift yesterday with no problems at all. Thanks for turning that around so quickly, it made a real difference for the team.

subject: Break room fridge not cooling
body: The break room fridge is not keeping anything cold right now, and the thermometer inside reads well above a safe temperature. This has been the case since this morning and we have already had to toss a few items. Someone should look at it before more food spoils.

subject: Payment gateway rejecting every transaction
body: The payment gateway is rejecting every transaction we send it right now, no matter the card or amount. This has been going on since the store opened and customers are backing up at the register. We have not found any workaround yet and need this looked at urgently.

subject: How maintenance ticket priority gets decided
body: How are priority levels assigned when a maintenance ticket comes in, and who decides whether something counts as urgent? I am drafting a short guide for new staff and want the description to match what actually happens. No current tickets prompted this, just documentation work.

subject: Closed out: intermittent printer error
body: The intermittent error that used to pop up on the third floor printer has not appeared since the driver update went out last week. We ran it through several large jobs without a single failure. Marking this closed unless someone sees it come back.

subject: Security camera feed still down
body: The camera feed for the rear entrance has been down since this morning and the monitor in the security office is still showing a blank screen. We have restarted the recorder twice without any change. Nobody can currently confirm who is coming in through that door.
